about:
Based in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, GM Cable Contractors Inc. operates as a communications infrastructure specialist serving the Gulf South region. The company provides design, engineering, and installation services for voice, data, and video networks, though its founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

Its service portfolio spans inside-plant and outside-plant construction, including LAN/WAN design and installation, fiber optic splicing and testing, directional boring for underground conduit placement, aerial cable installation, and CCTV/video surveillance systems. The firm also supplies on-site personnel for manpower contracts, allowing clients to scale technical staffing as needed.

Clients range from educational institutions — universities, community colleges, and K‑12 schools — to state and municipal government agencies, industrial plants, and healthcare facilities. The company cites a broad customer base across these sectors as a core part of its market focus.

GM Cable Contractors states its mission is to raise quality standards in broadband and communications technology through cabling, outside construction, and network design. It emphasizes consumer-driven support, cost-effective facilities, and a track record of meeting or exceeding client expectations.
